title: Document Publishing Input
description: Input schema for the document-publishing skill: render a document folio without a TeX installation.

format.description: Output format. All three assemble Markdown first; html and pdf then run pandoc.

pdfEngine.description: HTML-to-PDF engine. Never latexmk: a document folio is defined by not requiring TeX to publish.

css.description: Stylesheet path relative to the repo root. Belongs in the folio repo — a house style is content.

stagingLinks.description: The staging preview of the work under review, as the request for feedback carried it, so the reviewer opens the changed pages rather than rebuilding links. Rule: cat-harness skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule".

stagingLinks.title: Staging links
stagingLinks.description: The staging preview of the work a request for feedback is about: one deep link per changed page (the page and the anchor where the change sits) with the same page on main as `before`. Mirrors StagingComparison in schemas/sdlc/staging.ts. The rule is skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule". Copied inline as `definitions.stagingLinks` into every skill contract that carries it; schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.

slug.description: Branch slug used in the staging URL path.

pages.description: One entry per changed page, deep-linked; from the change's rendered-impact list, never chosen by judgement.

before.description: Same page on main; absent for a new page.

after.description: The page on the staging preview, with the anchor where the change sits; absent for a deleted page.

summary.description: What to look at on this page.

missing.description: What could not be linked, said rather than hidden: no preview yet (and when it will exist), no page list computed, or a changed page the publish ref does not hold.

stagingLinks.$comment: Copy of cat-harness schemas/staging-comparison.schema.json; cat-harness schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.
